ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels (central regions) to 25% low-intensity black pixels (edges and mottling).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field with dense black pigmentation (low intensity) at the leading edges, peduncle junction, and trailing edges. High-density cluster of dark focal spots (geometric blobs) located in the upper-right distal quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration map consisting of high-frequency peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-20 pixels) along the entire posterior boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted from the medial notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward-pointing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast dark circular clusters (potential barnacle scars or pigmentation spots) scattered across both lobes, with a concentrated group of roughly 12-15 distinct spots on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, dark linear streaks (rake marks) predominantly located on the central-left lobe and vertical streaks near the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible high-relief, cream-colored barnacle clusters (Coronula diadema) adhering to the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'leopard-like' pigmentation pattern consisting of dense black circular focal points on the upper-right quadrant of the ventral fluke surface.
